name: soc2_cc6_3
title: Role changes are reviewed
description: When a role is assigned, or an assignment is extended to last longer, an administrator who is neither the person who made the change nor the person it is about confirms or challenges it. Revoking a role opens no review: it narrows access, and the audit chain records who revoked what and when. Installed as drafts: nothing runs until a person publishes the process and the recipes. A tenant that installed an earlier version keeps it; installing this one adds drafts beside it.
